name: creations_upload_file
description: Import a file the host rewrote to a download URL (e.g. ChatGPT uploads) as a creation; use the identifier in image tools. Public URL: `creations_upload_image`.

download_url.description: URL the host rewrote this file to. Never fabricate one from a file id/attachment ref — no real URL means call `creations_upload_show` or `creations_request_upload`+`creations_finalize_upload` instead.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.
